how_to: فایل را به مترجم بده؛ خروجی را با نام fa-out-quest-elwynn-forest-01.json برگردان.
rules: به فارسی روان و معنادار ترجمه کن، نه آوانگاری؛ فقط نام خاص شخص/مکان آوانگاری می‌شود. هر ⟦...⟧ را دقیقاً همان‌طور و به تعداد اصلی نگه دار (جابه‌جایی در جمله مجاز است). عددها را حفظ کن (ارقام فارسی یا لاتین فرقی ندارد). ی و ک فارسی، نیم‌فاصله در «می‌»، «ها» و «ای». هیچ حرف لاتین در خروجی نباشد مگر داخل ⟦...⟧. از glossary برای واژه‌ها پیروی کن. خروجی فقط JSON: {"pack": <همین pack>, "fa": {"<کلید>": "ترجمه"}} با همهٔ کلیدهای rows، نه کم نه زیاد.
tokens_note: ⟦عدد⟧ = کد بازی (نام بازیکن، خط جدید، رنگ). ⟦E..⟧ = نام مصوب؛ معنی‌اش در entities است. هر دو را دست‌نخورده نگه دار.

rows.quest:11:obj:0: Bring 8 Painted Gnoll Armbands to Deputy Rainer at the Barracks.
rows.quest:11:details:0: Gnolls, brutish creatures with no decent business in these lands, have been seen along the borders of ⟦E1⟧. A large pack of them, many more than we can handle alone, have infested the woods south of the guard tower yonder. Another group has infested the areas near Stone Cairn Lake to the east.
rows.quest:11:details:1: BThe ⟦E2⟧ Army will commend whomever helps kill them. Bring me their painted gnoll armbands as proof of your deed.
rows.quest:11:completion:0: I see you've been busy! You have our thanks, ⟦1⟧.
rows.quest:35:obj:0: Marshal Dughan wants you to speak with Guard Thomas.
rows.quest:35:details:0: If you are concerned that the rumors of murlocs are true, then do this -- travel to the eastern Elwynn bridge and speak with Guard Thomas. He has been stationed at the bridge for the past week and will know the state of the area.
rows.quest:35:completion:0: Yes, murlocs have settled in and around the streams of eastern Elwynn. We don't know why they are here, but they are aggressive and at least semi-intelligent.
rows.quest:37:obj:0: Guard Thomas wants you to travel north up the river and search for the two lost guards, Rolf and Malakai.
rows.quest:37:details:0: A few days ago we sent two Guards, Rolf and Malakai, to investigate along the river, and they have not yet returned. To complete my report, I must know what happened to those men.
rows.quest:37:details:1: BTravel north along the river and find the guards... or their remains.
rows.quest:37:completion:0: Although much has been stripped from the corpse, strewn nearby is a medallion with the words: "Footman Malakai Stone" etched upon it.
rows.quest:39:obj:0: Report to Marshal Dughan in Goldshire.
rows.quest:39:details:0: Tell Marshal Dughan of Malakai and Rolf's deaths, and report to him that the Murlocs in eastern Elwynn cannot be contained by our current troop presence.
rows.quest:39:details:1: BI know we don't have many troops to spare, but hopefully Dughan can find someone.
rows.quest:39:completion:0: Hmm, this news is troubling. Already our defenses are stretched thin, and losing Rolf and Malakai to those murlocs put us in an even worse position.
rows.quest:39:completion:1: BIf things don't improve, there will be fighting in Goldshire by the week's end!
rows.quest:40:obj:0: Remy "Two Times" wants you to speak with Marshal Dughan in Goldshire.
rows.quest:40:details:0: ⟦2⟧, there's a new threat in ⟦E1⟧! Murlocs are swimming up the streams of eastern Elwynn, scaring away fish and attacking gentle folk!
rows.quest:40:details:1: BI warned Marshal Dughan, but he's more worried about the gnolls and the bandits. He's not convinced that the murlocs are a danger.
rows.quest:40:details:2: BPlease, ⟦3⟧, speak to Dughan and persuade him to send more troops to the east!
rows.quest:40:completion:0: Yes, I spoke with Remy. I respect him as a merchant, though all reports of Murlocs to the east have been sketchy at best.
rows.quest:40:completion:1: BYour concerns are noted, but unless I receive a military report of a murloc threat, we can't afford to send more troops east.
rows.quest:45:obj:0: Search the murloc village for Rolf, or signs of his death.
rows.quest:45:details:0: Upon further searching the area, you find webbed footprints leading east along the shore of Stone Cairn Lake. In the distance to the east, you can just barely see a Murloc village.
rows.quest:45:completion:0: You find around the neck of the corpse a metal medallion inscribed with the words "Footman Rolf Hartford."
rows.quest:46:obj:0: Bring 8 Torn Murloc Fins to Guard Thomas at the east Elwynn bridge.
rows.quest:46:details:0: The ⟦E2⟧ Army has placed a bounty on murloc lurkers and foragers in Elwynn. Slaughter them and bring me their torn murloc fins, and the ⟦E2⟧ Army will reward you well.
rows.quest:46:details:1: BThe murlocs have built a village at Stone Cairn Lake north of here, and another to the south where the stream forks.
rows.quest:46:completion:0: You have the fins? Great! Marshal Dughan is anxious about the Murloc situation in eastern Elwynn, and I'd like to tell him that it's becoming under control.
rows.quest:46:completion:1: BYour actions have helped realize that.
rows.quest:47:obj:0: Bring 10 Gold Dust to Remy "Two Times" in Goldshire. Gold Dust is gathered from Kobolds in ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:47:details:0: The Kobolds in these parts sometimes carry Gold Dust on them. I could really use the stuff - bring me a load of it and I'll give you the best price in town...best price in town!
rows.quest:47:details:1: BYou can find kobolds in the Fargodeep Mine to the south, and around the Jasperlode Mine to the northeast.
rows.quest:47:completion:0: Thanks for the dust, ⟦4⟧. Here's your cash, and...here is a token from associates of mine. You might find it useful...useful.
rows.quest:52:obj:0: Kill 8 Prowlers and 5 Young Forest Bears, and then return to Guard Thomas at the east Elwynn bridge.
rows.quest:52:details:0: Hail, ⟦5⟧. Wild animals are growing more and more aggressive the farther we get from Goldshire, and the Eastvale Logging Camp suffers nearly constant attacks from wolves and bears!
rows.quest:52:details:1: BWe could use your help out here.
rows.quest:52:completion:0: Thanks a lot for the help, ⟦6⟧. Something in the forest must be making these animals so bold.
rows.quest:52:completion:1: BWhatever it is, I hope it stays there.
rows.quest:59:obj:0: Give Sara Timberlain the ⟦E2⟧ Armor Marker.
rows.quest:59:details:0: For your shrewdness and valor, I have a marker here that is good for one piece of armor. I want you to take it to Sara Timberlain at the Eastvale Logging Camp. Give her the marker, and she will fashion the armor for you. And after you receive it, ⟦7⟧, use it in the defense of Elwynn.
rows.quest:59:details:1: BThe Eastvale Logging Camp is beyond Guard Thomas' post to the east.
rows.quest:59:completion:0: Ah, thank you for the marker. Please feel free to pick your choice of armor.
rows.quest:59:completion:1: BLuck to you, brave ⟦8⟧. And may this armor serve you well.
rows.quest:60:obj:0: Bring 8 Large Candles to William Pestle in Goldshire.
rows.quest:60:details:0: Hello, ⟦9⟧! Do you have a moment?
rows.quest:60:details:1: BMy brother and I run an apothecary in ⟦E2⟧, and I'm here to gather large candles for their wax. Can you help me?
rows.quest:60:details:2: BYou can get large candles from kobolds, and I hear rumors that kobolds are infesting the Elwynn mines ... the Fargodeep mine to the south and Jasperlode Mine to the east. I suggest looking for candles in one of those places.
rows.quest:60:completion:0: You were busy hunting kobolds, were you? Thanks for the candles, ⟦10⟧, and here's your reward...
rows.quest:61:obj:0: Bring William's Shipment to Morgan Pestle in the ⟦E2⟧ Trade District.
rows.quest:61:details:0: My brother Morgan is waiting in ⟦E2⟧ for my shipment of candles. I don't have enough time to make the trip myself, but if you'd like to take him the shipment, he'll pay you well.
rows.quest:61:details:1: BI've packed up the candles, and you can find Morgan in our shop, Pestle's Apothecary, in the ⟦E2⟧ Trade District.
rows.quest:61:completion:0: Here is your payment ... and while you're here, take a look around! I'm sure we have a potion or other trinket you'd find useful.
rows.quest:62:obj:0: Explore the Fargodeep Mine, then return to Marshal Dughan in Goldshire.
rows.quest:62:details:0: The mine in ⟦E3⟧ isn't the only one with problems! I have reports that the Fargodeep Mine in Elwynn has also become a haven for Kobolds.
rows.quest:62:details:1: BExplore the mine and confirm these reports, then return to me. The mine is almost due south of Goldshire, between the Stonefield and Maclure homesteads.
rows.quest:62:completion:0: This is bad news. What's next, dragons?!? We'll have to increase our patrols near that mine. Thanks for your efforts, ⟦11⟧. And hold a moment... I might have another task for you.
rows.quest:71:obj:0: Deliver Rolf and Malakai's Medallions to Guard Thomas at the eastern Elwynn bridge.
rows.quest:71:details:0: Now that you have both medallions, deliver them to Guard Thomas at the bridge so that he might know the fate of his murdered guards.
rows.quest:71:completion:0: You have confirmed my fears, ⟦12⟧. The murlocs are a threat we cannot ignore.
rows.quest:76:obj:0: Explore the Jasperlode Mine, then report back to Marshal Dughan in Goldshire.
rows.quest:76:details:0: Thanks to you we know the Fargodeep Mine is infested with kobolds. Now we need a scout to investigate the more distant Jasperlode Mine.
rows.quest:76:details:1: BExplore Jasperlode and confirm any kobold presence. To reach the mine, travel east along the road until you reach the Tower of Azora. From the tower, head north and you'll find the mine in the foothills.
rows.quest:76:completion:0: Kobolds at the Jasperlode Mine, you say? Curses! The situation is worsening by the minute!
rows.quest:76:completion:1: BThank you for the report, ⟦13⟧. But I wish that the news you brought was good news.
rows.quest:83:obj:0: Bring 6 Red Linen Bandanas to Sara Timberlain at the Eastvale Logging Camp.
rows.quest:83:details:0: The Defias gang in ⟦E3⟧ wears burlap masks, but the Defias in Elwynn wear ⟦E4⟧ which I can use to make fine ⟦E4⟧ goods.
rows.quest:83:details:1: BBring me red ⟦E4⟧ bandanas and I'll use them to fashion something for you.
rows.quest:83:details:2: BDefias gang members have camps pocketed throughout Elwynn.
rows.quest:83:completion:0: Ah, these are nice bandanas, if a little rough...
rows.quest:84:obj:0: Bring the Pork Belly Pie to Billy Maclure at the Maclure Vineyards.
rows.quest:84:details:0: Here you go. And when you give this pie to that Billy, you tell him I hope he chokes on it!
rows.quest:84:completion:0: Mm, yum! This pie is the best!
rows.quest:84:completion:1: BI think my memory is coming back to me...
rows.quest:85:details:0: I lost my necklace, and think that guttersnipe Billy Maclure took it! He's usually scuttling like a rat around the Maclure vineyards east of here.
rows.quest:85:details:1: BGet my necklace back for me, and you'll warm an old widow's heart.
rows.quest:85:completion:0: You lost a what? Well I didn't take no necklace, because I ain't no thief!
rows.quest:85:completion:1: BI might know who did but...⟦14⟧...I'm too hungry to remember.
rows.quest:86:obj:0: Bring 4 Chunks of Boar Meat to Auntie Bernice Stonefield at the Stonefield's Farm.
rows.quest:86:details:0: Maybe if I got a pie, I could tell you who has that necklace. And you know, I think that old Bernice lady at that other farm makes great Pork Belly Pies...
rows.quest:86:details:1: BMaybe if you gave her some chunks of boar meat from the boars that hang around our farms, and told her what it was for, she'd bake up a pie for you.
rows.quest:86:completion:0: Though this wild boar meat is tough, simmer it enough and it sure does make for some tasty pie!
rows.quest:87:obj:0: Bring Bernice's Necklace to "Auntie" Bernice Stonefield at the Stonefield Farm.
rows.quest:87:details:0: I was playing near the Fargodeep Mine, and I think I dropped, er...I mean I saw, the old lady's necklace. Don't ask me how it got there...it wasn't me!
rows.quest:87:details:1: BWell anyway, I saw this big, gold-toothed kobold pick up the necklace and run into the mine. Go find that kobold and you'll find the necklace, I swear!
rows.quest:87:completion:0: Oh, you found it! Thank you, thank you dear!
rows.quest:87:completion:1: BHere, take this. It was my husband's and he always said it was lucky. If only he didn't forget it on his last campaign! *sniff*
rows.quest:88:obj:0: Kill Princess, grab her collar, then bring it back to Ma Stonefield at the Stonefield Farm.
rows.quest:88:details:0: The Brackwells have a prize-winning pig, Princess. The sow is HUGE, and she got that way from sneaking over here and eating my veggies!
rows.quest:88:details:1: BSo before she comes to our fields...Princess must die! Bring me her collar as proof of the deed and I'll give you something for your time!
rows.quest:88:details:2: BPrincess is usually over at the Brackwell Pumpkin Patch, to the east and beyond the Maclure farm. Get her before she gets hungry and comes back here!
rows.quest:88:completion:0: Thank goodness! That pig was getting so big she'd have eaten our whole crop! Thank you, ⟦15⟧.
rows.quest:88:completion:1: BNow, do either of these suit you?
rows.quest:106:obj:0: Give Maybell's Love Letter to Tommy Joe Stonefield.
rows.quest:106:details:0: Oh, I'm cursed! My heart belongs to Tommy Joe Stonefield, but our families are bitter enemies. So I can't see him, even though my eyes ache to gaze upon that handsome face!
rows.quest:106:details:1: BPlease, take this letter and give it to Tommy Joe. He's usually at the river to the west of the Stonefield Farm, which is due west of here.
rows.quest:106:completion:0: Ah! I can't stand us being apart. I have to see her!!
rows.quest:107:obj:0: Take Gramma Stonefield's Note to William Pestle.
rows.quest:107:details:0: I bet William Pestle has a potion to unite our two young lovers!
rows.quest:107:details:1: BHere, take this note to William. He's staying at the Lion's Pride Inn in Goldshire.
rows.quest:107:completion:0: My heart goes out to those two poor souls, Maybell and Tommy Joe. I remember being young and in love, once.
rows.quest:107:completion:1: BThere must be something I can do to help them! Let me think...
rows.quest:109:obj:0: Talk to Gryan Stoutmantle. He usually can be found in the stone tower on Sentinel Hill, just off the road, in the middle of ⟦E5⟧.
rows.quest:109:details:0: Looks to me you've seen quite a bit of combat in your time, ⟦16⟧. If you haven't already, you should report to Gryan Stoutmantle. He heads up the People's Militia, aimed at protecting the farmlands of ⟦E5⟧. I bet he could use your help. You can usually find him in the stone tower on Sentinel Hill, just off the road in the middle of ⟦E5⟧.
rows.quest:109:completion:0: Ah, so my friend sent you here? How kind.
rows.quest:109:completion:1: BWell the ⟦E2⟧ Monarchy has abandoned our cause. Now it is up to the People's Militia to keep the land free from corruption. If our cause interests you, I can put your combat skills to use in the name of freedom.
rows.quest:111:details:0: Please, ⟦17⟧, talk with my Gramma. If anyone can find a way to bring me together with Maybell, she can.
rows.quest:111:details:1: BShe's inside our house east of here.
rows.quest:111:completion:0: While our families are feuding, Tommy Joe and Maybell don't have much of a future, but... maybe we can get them together for just a little while.
rows.quest:112:obj:0: Bring 4 Crystal Kelp Fronds to William Pestle in Goldshire.
rows.quest:112:details:0: I can make an ⟦E6⟧ liquor for Maybell, so she can slip away from the Maclure Vineyards and go to Tommy Joe. But to make the Liquor, I need some crystal kelp.
rows.quest:112:details:1: BAlthough the kelp usually grows in the ocean... sometimes murlocs collect it. See if the murlocs near Crystal Lake have any. Crystal Lake is just east of Goldshire.
rows.quest:112:completion:0: You got them. Good show! Now, just one moment while I concoct the potion...
rows.quest:114:obj:0: Take the Invisibility Liquor to Maybell Maclure.
rows.quest:114:details:0: Take this ⟦E6⟧ liquor to young Maybell. It should last long enough for her to visit Tommy Joe.
rows.quest:114:completion:0: Oh...my! I feel guilty deceiving my family, but my feelings for Tommy Joe are too strong to ignore.
rows.quest:114:completion:1: BThank you, ⟦18⟧. I'll drink this liquor as soon as I have the chance and sneak away to my love.
rows.quest:114:completion:2: BAnd for you... please take this.
rows.quest:123:obj:0: Go to Marshal Dughan in Goldshire and give him The Collector's Schedule.
rows.quest:123:details:0: This note is a schedule with a list of days and times when a person -- described only as "The Collector" -- will receive a shipment of gold from the mines in ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:123:details:1: BFrom the schedule, it looks as if the Collector resides near the Brackwell Pumpkin Patch in eastern Elwynn.
rows.quest:123:details:2: BThis sounds important. You should report it to Marshal Dughan in Goldshire.
rows.quest:123:completion:0: Hm... I have heard of this "Collector" but I don't know whom he's working for. Thank you for the schedule. It will help us solve this mystery.
rows.quest:147:obj:0: Find and kill "the Collector" then return to Marshal Dughan with The Collector's Ring.
rows.quest:147:details:0: If the "Collector" is taking gold from our mines then he's stealing from the kingdom! Bring the Collector to justice, and bring me the ring mentioned in the pickup schedule you gave me. It may tell us whom the Collector is working for...
rows.quest:147:details:1: BThat Pickup Schedule says the Collector is hiding out at the Brackwell Pumpkin Patch. You should search for him there.
rows.quest:147:completion:0: You found him? Well done, ⟦19⟧. He won't be "collecting" from the Elwynn Mines again!
rows.quest:147:completion:1: BAnd this ring you found is interesting... it's a membership ring for the old Stonemason's Guild in ⟦E2⟧. Why would a lowly thief have an artisan guild ring, and why are the Defias Thieves collecting money from our mines?
rows.quest:147:completion:2: BDifficult questions. I hope one day we'll have answers.
rows.quest:176:obj:0: Slay the gnoll Hogger and bring his Huge Gnoll ⟦E7⟧ to Marshal Dughan.
rows.quest:176:details:1: BA huge gnoll, Hogger, is prowling the woods in southwestern Elwynn. He has overpowered all attempts at his capture.
rows.quest:176:details:2: BThe ⟦E2⟧ Army has placed a generous bounty on the Gnoll. To earn the reward, bounty hunters should bring proof of Hogger's demise to Marshal Dughan in Goldshire.
rows.quest:176:completion:0: Hah! Well done! I was starting to think no one would take down that monster!
rows.quest:176:completion:1: BHere you are, ⟦20⟧. And thanks - that Gnoll was giving me a headache the size of Blackrock Spire!
rows.quest:239:obj:0: Go to the Westbrook ⟦E8⟧ and speak with Deputy Rainer.
rows.quest:239:details:0: The ⟦E8⟧ on our western border sends word of increasing gnoll and thief activity. They're requesting we send more ⟦E2⟧ soldiers... but we just don't have any to spare!
rows.quest:239:details:1: BIf you can help, we could use it. Go and speak with Deputy Rainer at the Westbrook ⟦E8⟧ and see what he needs done.
rows.quest:239:details:2: BThe ⟦E8⟧ is down the road to the west. After you cross the bridge over the small brook it will be to the right.
rows.quest:239:completion:0: Marshall Dughan sent you, eh? Well you're not from the army, but if Dughan sent you then that's good enough for me!
rows.quest:239:completion:1: BOur situation is, to say the least, a stressed one. I hope you can give us a hand.
rows.quest:2158:obj:0: Speak with ⟦E9⟧ Farley at the Lion's Pride Inn.
rows.quest:2158:details:0: Every adventurer should rest when exhaustion sets in - and there is no finer place to get rest and relaxation than at the Lion's Pride Inn!
rows.quest:2158:details:1: BMy best friend, ⟦E9⟧ Farley, runs the Lion's Pride. If you tell him I sent you, he may give you the special discounted rates on food and drink.
rows.quest:2158:details:2: BTo find the Lion's Pride Inn, travel south along the road from here -- you can't miss it!
rows.quest:2158:completion:0: Rest and relaxation for the tired and cold -- that's our motto! Please, take a seat by the fire and rest your weary bones.
rows.quest:2158:completion:1: BWould you like to try a sampling of some of our fine food and drink?
rows.quest:5545:obj:0: Bring 8 Bundles of Wood to Raelen at the Eastvale Logging Camp.
rows.quest:5545:details:0: I've got a real problem on my hands. I have a deadline looming for an order of lumber, and I'm running out of time. The wolves and bears north of here have chased my workers away from the bundles of wood that they've already chopped.
rows.quest:5545:details:1: BI've already talked to Deputy Rainer about clearing the animals, but I need someone to go collect the wood for me. If you could collect eight bundles of wood for me I might just make my deadline.
rows.quest:5545:completion:0: Excellent! Thanks to you, I should be able to complete the order in time. To show my gratitude, I would like to offer some coin as compensation for your troubles.
